description.zh: 读取 text-to-cad 技能自带的文件（references/*.md 参考文档、scripts 等），路径形如 "cad/references/step-generation.md"；给目录则列出内容；不给 path 则返回 text-to-cad 版本、cadgen 运行时是否可用及技能列表。
description.en: Read files shipped with the text-to-cad skills (references/*.md, scripts, …), path like "cad/references/step-generation.md"; a folder lists its contents; no path returns the text-to-cad version, whether the cadgen runtime is available, and the skill list.

path.description: 技能目录内的相对路径，如 cad/references/positioning.md；留空返回状态
path inside the skills folder, e.g. cad/references/positioning.md; empty returns status
